Room booking

The whole app scrolls inside one wrapper. The panel below has a fixed width.

Book the library meeting room for up to two hours at a time, between eight in the morning and four in the afternoon on school days.

Bookings are confirmed by email. Cancel at least a day ahead so someone else can use the room.

Rooms with a projector: the library meeting room and the board room. Ask the front office for the remote.

Rooms without a projector: the counseling office conference table and the staff lounge.
